worked: Single, age 63. Every subtraction that comes before Line 6 is taken before the private pension income test: the test is 24,000, under the limit, so the 6,000 is whole. Line 6 is after every Form MO-A Part 1 subtraction (gains, military, railroad, business income) and the Line 1 addition of other states' bond interest, and before the Line 8 Social Security and pension exemptions; Section B then takes taxable Social Security off. Federal taxable Social Security: other income 49,000.00 + tax-exempt interest 3,000.00 + half of benefits 9,000.00 = provisional 61,000.00; lesser of 85% x 18,000.00 = 15,300.00 and 85% x (61,000.00 - 34,000.00) + 4,500.00 = 27,450.00: 15,300.00. Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages 9,706.48 + self-employment net profit 10,000.00 - deductible half of self-employment tax 706.48 (10,000.00 x 92.35% x 15.3% / 2) + pensions 24,000.00 (military 12,000.00, railroad 6,000.00, private 6,000.00) + short-term gains 1,000.00 + long-term gains 5,000.00 + taxable Social Security 15,300.00 = 64,300.00. Federal taxable income = 64,300.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 48,550.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form MO-1040 Line 1 federal AGI 64,300.00. Line 2 additions: MO-A Part 1 Line 1 other states' bond interest 1,000.00 (Missouri bond interest 2,000.00 is not added). Line 3 total income 65,300.00. Line 4 subtractions: MO-A Part 1 Line 10 military retirement 12,000.00; Line 11 railroad retirement 6,000.00; Line 17 business income deduction, 20% of net profit 10,000.00 = 2,000.00; Line 18 capital gain 6,000.00; total 26,000.00. Line 6 Missouri adjusted gross income 65,300.00 - 26,000.00 = 39,300.00. MO-A Part 3 Section C (Y, age 63): Line 1 15,300.00; Line 3 15,300.00 (62 or older by December 31). Section C Line 4 total 15,300.00. Section B: Line 1 39,300.00; Line 2 15,300.00; Line 3 24,000.00; Line 4 25,000.00; Line 5 0.00; Line 6Y 6,000.00, Line 7Y 6,000.00; Line 8 6,000.00; Line 9 6,000.00. Projection measure: federal AGI 64,300.00 + tax-exempt interest 3,000.00 - Missouri bond interest 2,000.00 - taxable Social Security 15,300.00 - capital_gain_subtraction 6,000.00 - military_retirement_subtraction 12,000.00 - railroad_retirement_exempt 6,000.00 - business_income_deduction 2,000.00 = 24,000.00. Form MO-1040 Line 8 pension and Social Security exemption 21,300.00. Lines 9-13 federal income tax deduction not applied (not modelled; the household's federal tax is not an input). Line 14 standard deduction 15,750.00. Line 26 subtotal 39,300.00 - 21,300.00 - 15,750.00 = 2,250.00. Line 29 taxable income 2,250.00. Tax by the bands (0% to 1,313): 2% x 937.00 = 18.74; total 18.74 = 18.74. The chart and Tax Calculation Worksheet (instructions p21) round to the dollar and give 19; expected keeps the bands. state_agi (after every relief, as the check format defines it) = Line 6 39,300.00 - Line 8 21,300.00 = 18,000.00; the form's Missouri AGI is Line 6, 39,300.00.
accepted_approximations: The chart's cumulative amounts are rounded to whole dollars and the tax to the nearest dollar; the bands here do neither.
The federal income tax deduction is not applied (not_modelled).

The business income deduction is applied to all self-employment income; it applies to Missouri-source income only, and it also reaches Schedule E Part 2 income, Schedule F and Form 4835 profit, which the projection leaves out.
